text:
The Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, so if you're heading onto the lake, make it a short trip and get back before evening. Here in Burlington, Wednesday has played out cool, cloudy, and mostly dry, with temperatures holding around 57 and just a stray shower possible. The afternoon stays quiet, but northwest winds pick up tonight, reaching 15 to 25 knots on the lake with waves building to 2 to 4 feet. A shower remains possible before 8, then it’s a chilly, breezy night with temperatures falling to around 43.

Thursday is the payoff, mostly sunny with a high near 53. The north wind stays noticeable in the morning, then eases during the afternoon, and the lake settles down. Rain showers become likely after 4am Friday, so enjoy any outdoor plans Thursday, but don’t count on a dry start Friday.
